spans.s: Vṛndāraka, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4547.--§ 593 (Abhimanyuvadhap.): VII, 37, 1610 (attacked Abhimanyu); 47, 1872 (Kurūṇāṃ kīrtivardhanaṃ, slain by Abhimanyu, C. has by error Vṛkshārakaṃ).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 127, 5178 (among several sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra who attacked Bhīmasena), (), 5204 (Kurūnāṃ kīrtivardhanaṃ, slain by Bhīmasena).
